surface_mechanism_description: The ALD process involves a cyclic sequence of gas–surface interactions. A substrate is exposed to a reactive precursor, followed by an inert gas purge to remove all but the chemisorbed species. A second reactant is then admitted to form the film at monolayer or sub-monolayer thickness.
evidence: The ALD process involves a cyclic sequence of gas–surface interactions. A substrate is exposed to a reactive precursor, followed by an inert gas purge to remove all but the chemisorbed species. A second reactant is then admitted to form the film at monolayer or sub-monolayer thickness. The presence of a native oxide layer on silicon and the crystallisation behavior under electron beam irradiation are discussed, indicating the influence of surface conditions on crystallisation.
